subject: Acme: Private Control Plane — SAML/SCIM integration handshake
messages:
From: Sabrina Gomez <sabrina.gomez@acme.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-security@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-27T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private control plane SAML/SCIM — initial questions

Hi Nikhil,

We're starting planning for our Private Control Plane integration and want to align on SSO + provisioning expectations before the kickoff. A few concrete asks from our side:

- SCIM: do you support push provisioning (service-initiated) and delta sync? What SCIM schema extensions do you expect for role mapping?
- SAML: which assertion attributes does Redwood require (email, name, groups, role claim)? Preferred NameID format?
- Service accounts: what IAM roles must be bound to the Redwood service account for provisioning and admin actions?
- Audit & retention: what events are logged (auth events, SCIM changes, admin changes) and retention windows for Private deployments?
- Endpoints & metadata: please share SP endpoints and expected metadata formats so we can prepare ours.

Would it be possible to get a short checklist and the SAML/SP metadata so we can validate with our IdP team? Also proposing a 30-minute call tomorrow (11/28) to walk through mapping — what's your availability?

Thanks,
Sabrina Gomez
Identity Engineer, Acme Corp
[sabrina.gomez@acme.com]
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Gomez <sabrina.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private control plane SAML/SCIM — initial questions

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support both SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for Private Control Plane customers. I've attached a short integration checklist and our SCIM schema example to get started (see attachments).

Immediate answers to your bullets:
- SCIM: we support full CRUD over SCIM v2 with incremental (delta) sync. Group push is supported via group endpoints; we also accept group membership attributes on user objects for environments that prefer to manage groups at the IdP.
- SAML attributes: we request: name, email (verified/email), groups (multi-valued), and a role claim (optional) for direct role mapping. NameID in Email format is our usual preference but we can accept transient if your IdP requires it.
- Service account roles: we will need a service account with the ability to call SCIM endpoints and read metadata; for Private deployments we ask that the account be scoped to the Control Plane network and assigned a least-privilege role list — I'll attach the baseline role map.
- Audit & retention: Control Plane emits auth events, SCIM provisioning events, admin actions, and model routing changes. Default retention in Private is 180 days; can be extended per contract.

Can you send your SAML metadata and a sample SCIM base URL for the staging IdP? We have availability for a 30-min sync on 2026-11-28 at 10:00 or 15:00 PST — which works for you?

Attachments: redwood-privcp-id-checklist.pdf, scim-schema.json

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

---
Internal notes (do not forward):
- Laura: confirm exact role mappings + required admin audit events list.
- Marcus: prepare SP metadata and a staging test tenant in our Private staging cluster.
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Gomez <sabrina.gomez@acme.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private control plane SAML/SCIM — initial questions

Thanks Sabrina & Nikhil — adding detail from a control-plane operations perspective.

Quick mapping checklist (what we need from Acme to complete a DRY run):
- SAML: metadata XML (entityID, SingleSignOnService, SingleLogoutService if used), assertion attributes: email (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress), givenName, familyName, groups (multivalued), roles (optional claim). Please indicate NameID format preference.
- SCIM: staging base URL, authentication method (Bearer token vs mTLS), delta token support? Are you exposing /Users and /Groups endpoints per RFC7643/7644?
- Role mapping: provide a CSV of IdP group -> Redwood role. I've attached a role-mapping-template.csv you can fill. For Private we recommend a three-tier role mapping: admin (full CP admin), operator (deployment/scale only), viewer (read-only).
- Service account: needs network access to the Control Plane management endpoint. For on-prem deployments this is typically a customer-managed service account with IP allowlist to the Control Plane.
- Audit/logs: we capture: login attempts, SAML assertion validation failures, SCIM patch events (who/when/what), admin policy changes. Our default retention is 180 days; if Acme needs longer we can propose archival options.

Operational asks:
- Please share your SAML metadata and sample SCIM calls ahead of our sync — we'll validate mapping and share the SP metadata.
- We'll run a canary provisioning test (10 users, 2 groups) in staging; if successful we'll expand to full sync.

Attachments: role-mapping-template.csv

Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Infra Security
Redwood Inference
From: Sabrina Gomez <sabrina.gomez@acme.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private control plane SAML/SCIM — initial questions

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. Attached are the items you requested: acme-saml-metadata.xml and a short SCIM docs export (acme-scim-docs.pdf). A couple follow-ups before the call:

- NameID: our IdP team prefers EmailNameID by default; we can test transient but will aim for email.
- Auth for SCIM: we use Bearer tokens for provisioning in staging; for production we can negotiate mTLS if Redwood recommends it.
- Group model: we prefer push for groups (group push + group mems) but can switch to user attribute-based membership if needed. Does Redwood support both approaches for role lookups?

Let's take the 10:00 PST slot tomorrow (2026-11-28T10:00:00-08:00). I'll invite our IdP engineer as well.

Sabrina

Attachments included: acme-saml-metadata.xml, acme-scim-docs.pdf
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private control plane SAML/SCIM — integration handshake (internal next steps)

Internal follow-up after the Acme sync (call notes + owners):

Summary of the call:
- Acme will provide SAML metadata and a staging SCIM bearer token (they've attached both). NameID = email (preferred). They will push groups.
- SCIM: staging supports /Users and /Groups, delta tokens OK. They will start with a canary of 10 users + 2 groups.
- Production: may require mTLS for SCIM; engineering to assess ease of supporting mTLS per tenant.

Action items:
- Marcus: generate SP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, logout) and post to the Confluence playbook by EOD 2026-11-30. Then create a staging tenant and hand credentials to Sabrina for the canary. (JIRA-RED-7891)
- Laura: finalize role mapping policy and the minimum audit events list. Update role-mapping-template.csv with Redwood role IDs and return to Acme. Target 2026-12-01.
- Nikhil (me): draft a short cutover runbook for the transition from canary -> full sync, include rollback steps and a one-hour maintenance window request. Also capture the network allowlist requirements for the service account. Target 2026-12-02.

Notes on edge cases to validate during canary:
- Group name collisions (same group name across different groups) -> we should prioritize group UUID when provided.
- SCIM PATCH semantics for bulk changes -> confirm idempotency and event ordering in our audit logs.

Related links: https://confluence.redwood.ai/privcp/idp-integration-playbook, JIRA-RED-7891

I'll assign tasks in Jira and ping once staging tenant is ready.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Senior Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
